name: Konoha
source:
An energetic girl who’s never seemed to fit in, Konoha’s always stood on the sidelines. But as you get to know her, it soon becomes clear that she’s truly one of a kind.

Can you help her find her place in this world, or will her insatiable appetite overcome you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.reversevampire&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dreversevampire_web]Google Play[/url]]
